subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for browser/search hardening, or should maintainers split it into narrower browser-backend, search-provider, and Lightpanda evaluation trackers?
rationale: The current code shows unresolved work, but the request combines runtime security boundaries, product scope, dependency evaluation, and benchmark design that automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical issues for browser backend/security, search-provider reliability, and Lightpanda evaluation, then close this umbrella only after the split is complete.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-owned coordination point and require implementation PRs to link explicit security and benchmark evidence back here.

options.title: Drop Lightpanda Scope
options.body: Keep browser/search hardening open while explicitly deciding not to evaluate Lightpanda as a supported candidate for now.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
recommendation.body: Create or designate separate canonical issues for browser backend/security, search-provider reliability, and Lightpanda evaluation, then close this umbrella only after the split is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal across the browser, sandbox, and web-search paths named by the issue.
